The parties, herein referred to as 'Tech Innovators Inc.' and 'Creative Solutions LLC', agree to maintain the confidentiality of all proprietary information exchanged, commencing on November 1, 2023. Tech Innovators Inc. must not disclose any confidential information to third parties without prior written consent from Creative Solutions LLC. Creative Solutions LLC is obligated to use the confidential information solely for the purpose of evaluating potential business collaborations. Both parties must implement reasonable security measures to protect the confidentiality of the shared information, with periodic reviews conducted every six months to ensure compliance.

Section 2. Automatic Renewal of Service Agreement
This Agreement between Stellar Services Inc. ('Provider') and Greenfield Enterprises LLC ('Client') shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms commencing on January 1, 2024, unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the expiration of the current term. Provider must ensure that all services under this Agreement continue to meet the agreed-upon performance standards throughout the renewal term. Client is obligated to remit payment for the subsequent term in accordance with the existing payment schedule. Either party may, at their discretion, opt out of automatic renewal by fulfilling the notice requirement detailed herein.

Section 3. Rights and Obligations Assignment
Effective as of March 1, 2024, Tech Innovations LLC ('Assignor') hereby assigns to Global Ventures Inc. ('Assignee') all rights, title, and interest in and to the patent portfolio known as 'SmartTech Solutions' (the 'Patents'). Assignor must deliver all relevant documentation and executed instrument of transfer to Assignee by March 15, 2024. Assignee must formally accept the transfer and notify Assignor of such acceptance by March 20, 2024.

Section 4. Amendment to Service Agreement
This Amendment to the Service Agreement ("Agreement") originally entered into by and between Orion Tech Solutions, Inc. ("Orion") and Stellar Innovations, LLC ("Stellar") on January 15, 2023, hereby modifies the terms as follows: Effective November 1, 2023, Orion shall expand its scope of services to include cloud storage solutions as specified in Exhibit B attached hereto. Orion must deliver the additional services by December 31, 2023. Stellar agrees to provide the necessary access to their existing infrastructure by November 10, 2023, to facilitate the integration of such services. All other terms and conditions of the original Agreement remain in full force and effect unless expressly modified herein.

Section 5. Intellectual Property Rights and Obligations
Effective as of November 1, 2023, both parties, Innovatech Solutions, Inc. ('Innovatech') and GreenFuture Technologies, LLC ('GreenFuture'), hereby agree that all intellectual property ('IP') developed jointly under this Agreement shall be co-owned by both parties. Innovatech must not disclose any proprietary information to third parties without prior written consent from GreenFuture. GreenFuture must ensure that any IP developed independently by either party before the execution date shall remain the sole property of the developing party. Both parties must submit any claims related to IP breaches to arbitration within 30 days of the alleged breach.
